content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Panjab University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant and Project Associate posts at Panjab University is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant and Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: For Project Assistant, a Graduate degree in any discipline is required. For Project Associate, a Postgraduate degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Management, Commerce, Education, Public Policy, or Social Work with at least 55% marks is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without any financial obligation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant and Project Associate roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 6000 to Rs. 30625 per month, depending on the specific post and its requirements. Project Assistant roles have salaries of Rs. 20000 and Rs. 6000, while Project Associate offers Rs. 30625.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available in this Panjab University recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available for the posts of Project Assistant and Project Associate. These are distributed across different Project Assistant roles and one Project Associate role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility and then selected by a project-related Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if any, category certificate if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Panjab University, Chandigarh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxation benefits for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Chandigarh apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any discipline meeting the eligibility criteria can apply. The walk-in drive is an opportunity for all eligible candidates to attend the interview.
